title: Comparison of Ultramicrotomy and Electropolishing for TEM Observations of Al-Mg-Zn Thin Foils
content: The understanding of materials properties such as mechanical, magnetic, electrical, and corrosion resistance, upon a variety of different treating and processing conditions leverages the design of novel materials as well as the development of materials of improved properties. To being able to control and act upon these different properties researchers need to characterize the materials of interest using several tools to assess the important parameters at different length scales. When it comes to the nanometer and atomic scale (scanning) transmission electron microscopy (STEM and TEM) plays a fundamental role in the studies of materials properties.
